summary:
Portfolio net worth stands around M$604 with a tightly constrained spendable balance near the M$100 operational floor (currently M$10). The portfolio holds 11 active positions, anchored by core "Timeline NO" and site-outage frameworks alongside a high-conviction personal YES bet on a 5-year partner milestone. The long-awaited resolution cluster from August 11-14 (covering WTI, Geometry Dash, and AI weekly bets) continues to experience latency and remains unresolved, locking approximately M$345 in value and delaying the immediate execution of our high-conviction watchlist (including Anglo American/Teck merge NO, US-Iran peace talks NO, and Ukraine territory NO).

Open positions are generally sound and passing the re-open test. The Starship Ship 40 recovery NO position is currently moving against us (priced around 40%, generating a M$-13 unrealized loss) following a price bounce, but our thesis—grounded in Elon Musk's statements that the vehicle is likely lost at sea—remains dominant, and a concrete exit trigger has been logged to sell if official recovery is confirmed. A standing note and to-do item are in place to prioritize settling our M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 immediately upon the release of the pending liquidity cluster.

Concrete mistakes to avoid repeating include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without fully accounting for multi-day resolution latency, dabbling in marginal tactical YES bets or base-rate propositions that dilute strategic focus, and holding vague "something happen" sentiment markets lacking structural edges. Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic end-of-month and anniversary hype where developers release teasers rather than full deliverables, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship and milestone markets require strict carve-outs from our core strategic purity rules.
